rules.value: a placed actor whose class chain, read through the class-default reader, reaches Engine.BlockingVolume is a VOLS volume of kind blocking (VOLS.kind payload code 0)
rules.provenance: class chains decompiled from the locked system/Engine.u (sha256 9b04ff5cb4258e84dfa8efbdd85d9121f3bdcb5822a9a21ca69d200d05a69761) through the pinned UELib (sha256 64ebfa8b290429b9d5b5e81f5018734c03ded27bb814c69b904cc269268f7bbc) by scripts/native_assets_lib/class_defaults.py cached_class_chain: Engine.BlockingVolume extends Engine.Volume; the payload code is ours, not a Lineage II value (OVERNIGHT-DECISIONS row 937)

rules.value: a placed actor whose class chain reaches Engine.PhysicsVolume (GamePlay.WaterVolume, Engine.DefaultPhysicsVolume and every other subclass) is a VOLS volume of kind physics (VOLS.kind payload code 1); an actor whose chain reaches neither base class, such as Engine.MusicVolume, is not a VOLS volume
rules.provenance: class chains decompiled from the locked system/Engine.u (sha256 9b04ff5cb4258e84dfa8efbdd85d9121f3bdcb5822a9a21ca69d200d05a69761) and system/GamePlay.u (sha256 714639cdad265a7caeaf0f91ce76bb50492390eaa3faea15ed5a28a3e830b64a) through the pinned UELib (sha256 64ebfa8b290429b9d5b5e81f5018734c03ded27bb814c69b904cc269268f7bbc): Engine.PhysicsVolume and Engine.MusicVolume extend Engine.Volume, GamePlay.WaterVolume and Engine.DefaultPhysicsVolume extend Engine.PhysicsVolume; the payload code is ours (OVERNIGHT-DECISIONS row 937)

rules.value: each VOLS volume carries bL2WaterVolume (bool) as VOLS.water, Priority (int) as VOLS.priority, Gravity (Vector) as VOLS.gravity and TerminalVelocity (float) as VOLS.terminalVelocity, each authored on the actor, a class default, or ue-zero; a field the volume's class chain does not declare with that type is unresolved and never defaulted
rules.provenance: field declarations of Engine.PhysicsVolume in the locked system/Engine.u (sha256 9b04ff5cb4258e84dfa8efbdd85d9121f3bdcb5822a9a21ca69d200d05a69761) read through the pinned UELib (sha256 64ebfa8b290429b9d5b5e81f5018734c03ded27bb814c69b904cc269268f7bbc) by scripts/native_assets_lib/class_defaults.py read_class_field_declarations: bL2WaterVolume:bool, Priority:int, Gravity:Vector, TerminalVelocity:float; GamePlay.WaterVolume (system/GamePlay.u sha256 714639cdad265a7caeaf0f91ce76bb50492390eaa3faea15ed5a28a3e830b64a) defaultproperties set bL2WaterVolume true and no class in the chain sets bWaterVolume, so bL2WaterVolume is the water flag the scripts author (OVERNIGHT-DECISIONS rows 675 and 937)
rules.runtimeDefault: bL2WaterVolume is the water flag; unresolved fields stay unresolved

rules.value: a placement or volume blocks the player when bCollideActors and bBlockPlayers both resolve true; either resolving false is declared-none

rules.value: the Elbera cross-check also requires bStatic, bBlockActors and bBlockNonZeroExtentTraces true; when it disagrees with collision.blocking-flags the object is collision-unreadable with evidence rule-disagreement:<field> until owner review

rules.value: UseSimpleLineCollision, UseSimpleBoxCollision, UseSimpleKarmaCollision and CollisionModel select the static mesh collision route; an authored true selector or an authored CollisionModel is collision-unreadable until that route is decoded
rules.provenance: Engine.StaticMesh has no class export in the Interlude system/Engine.u (class_defaults resolve fails: intrinsic class), and no 20_21 StaticMesh export serializes these fields; route names from .planning/reference/lineage2js/03-movement.md:121
rules.runtimeDefault: omitted selectors are recorded as unresolved-intrinsic in the placement evidence and do not change the slot route

rules.value: SMSH triangles are the LOD0 triangles of the slots whose decoded EnableCollision is true, read from the converted model and mapped back to mesh-local source units by the inverse of SOURCE_TO_GLTF, with each triangle's vertex order reversed to undo that axis reflection
rules.provenance: slot EnableCollision decoded by scripts/native_assets_lib/static_materials.py into the glTF material extras nativeSlotProperties; the serialized UStaticMesh collision triangle layout (reference collision.staticMeshLayout, .planning/reference/lineage2js/03-movement.md) is not decoded yet

rules.value: world = Location + (local - PrePivot) scaled by DrawScale3D and DrawScale, then rotated by Rotation, in the row order of scripts/world/static_placement.py static_matrix
rules.provenance: localToWorld from Location, Rotation, DrawScale, DrawScale3D and PrePivot in .planning/reference/lineage2js/03-movement.md:121; the same order as the static placement matrix
rules.runtimeDefault: static_matrix order; used here only to assign a volume to a chunk

rules.value: a walk carries an outside bit that starts at bRootOutside; the front child sets it to outside or csg, the back child to outside and not csg; a missing child reached with the bit false is solid; csg is NumVertices > 0 and NodeFlags without 0x01 or 0x20
PolyFlags are recorded per BSP node for diagnostics and never change a solidity record
